semiconductor_relevance: High — KCENC plays a critical role in the semiconductor value chain by providing essential infrastructure services for semiconductor fabrication facilities.
summary: KCENC specializes in constructing ultra-high purity environments and providing comprehensive engineering services for semiconductor and display equipment manufacturing. Their offerings include ultra-pure utility piping, HVAC systems, and contamination control, crucial for maintaining optimal conditions in clean rooms. They also provide waste control and effluent management systems, positioning themselves as leaders in facility and infrastructure services for semiconductor manufacturing.
